fields.summary: Smoke test: Export In-App to a different project
fields.description:
Smoke test plan for KING-19550. Proves the new export functionality works; this is not a regression suite.

> **Latest run: 20 Aug 2026 — 🟢 feature** `live` · 🔴 conformance `failed` (11 pass / 2 fail / 1 blocked).  
> Full report in the comments. **This description is the plan; every run is a comment.**

**Grounding:** 3 of 14 expected results rest on **observed behaviour alone** — steps 6, 7 and 9, marked `[live-confirmed]`.

## How to read this plan

This test answers **two independent questions**. Report both.

**Run the** `[GATE]` steps first — 1, 2, 3, 5, 11, 12. Every gate passing is `live`; some passing is `partially live`; none is `not live`.

## Preconditions

* Operator access to **two projects on TEST** — a source and a destination.
* An In-App in the source project whose dependency set spans all three summary buckets.
* Destination project integration settings otherwise matching source.

> ⚠ **This plan consumes its own preconditions.** Every run creates the source In-App's dependencies in the destination, so that In-App can never again demonstrate _Can be created_ — its bucket is empty next time. **Pick a fresh In-App for the export path each run.**

> **A dirty destination does not block this test.** Every entity list in the dashboard carries a **created-date** column, so this run's entities are distinguishable from earlier runs' without cleaning anything.

**Known-good setup:**

* Source: **Export project**. Destination: **DK Project**.
* Gate / export path: any In-App **not yet exported to the destination** — check the destination's In-App list first.

## Steps

**1.** `[GATE]` Open the In-App list in the source project and open the row's Action List.
_Expected:_ An **Export** action is present. `[Story]` _(Its position between Publish and Clone is_ `[live-confirmed]`_.)_

**2.** `[GATE]` Click **Export**.
_Expected:_ The export modal opens. `[Story]`

**2a.** Inspect the modal's controls.
_Expected:_ A modal over a dimmed backdrop, headed **Export In-App** with an **X** close control, showing the selected In-App with its status chip, a **Destination Project** label with a dropdown containing the placeholder `Select Project...`, a **Cancel** button, and an **Export** button that is **disabled**. `[Figma: Export modal]`

> ⚠ **Fails on every run — the build renders the dropdown empty, with no placeholder.** Cosmetic and non-blocking: the dropdown works, step 3 uses it successfully.

**3.** `[GATE]` Open the **Destination Project** dropdown.
_Expected:_ A searchable project list appears with a **Search...** field. `[Figma: Export modal]`

> The dropdown has its **own** `Search...` field, distinct from the page's sidebar `Search`.

**4.** Select the destination project.
_Expected:_ A **Verifying...** progress state appears while the dependency scan runs. `[Figma: Export modal]`

**5.** `[GATE]` Wait for the scan to finish.
_Expected:_ In the **same** modal — no second popup — an info banner reads _"The system has analyzed dependencies in the destination project. Please review the proposed actions below."_, followed by a heading **Export validation summary** and a **Refresh** control. `[Figma → live-confirmed]`

**6.** Read the **Already exist and can be reused** section.
_Expected:_ The 100%-match dependency is listed, its row reading **Already exist and can be reused**, and it is **not** repeated under _Can be created_. `[live-confirmed]`

**7.** Read the **Can be created** section.
_Expected:_ Each missing dependency is listed, its row reading **Can be created**. `[live-confirmed]`

> **Write down the entity names and the row count here, before going any further.** Step 13 checks that each one was created.

**8.** Read the **Cannot be exported (conflicts)** section.
_Expected:_ The In-App itself is listed with the reason **Some entities block export**, and beneath it the type-mismatched player field with the reason **Has different type.** `[Figma → live-confirmed]`

**9.** With the conflicts section present, inspect the **Export** button.
_Expected:_ **Export is disabled** — a conflict blocks the whole export, it does not proceed with the remaining entities. `[live-confirmed]`

**10.** Remove the conflicting entity from the destination project, return to the modal and click **Refresh**.
_Expected:_ The **Cannot be exported (conflicts)** section disappears and **Export** becomes enabled. `[Story]`

> ⚠ **Known defect — KING-22355.** Deleting the destination player field does _not_ clear the conflict, because the delete is a soft delete and the validator still counts the entity.

**11.** `[GATE]` Click **Export**.
_Expected:_ The modal closes and the export completes. `[Story]`

**12.** `[GATE]` Open the destination project and locate the In-App.
_Expected:_ The In-App **exists** in the destination project — this is what proves the feature works end to end. `[AC-3]` _(Conformance: its status is_ **In-Review**_._ `[PRD → live-confirmed]`_)_

> Step 12 asserts `In-Review` because that is what the build does. **AC-3 and the PRD both say** `Draft` and are contradicted by the build — confirmed on two runs.

**13.** Inspect dependencies in the destination project — **Events**, **Segments**, **Resources** and **User fields** under App Settings.
_Expected:_ Every entity recorded at step 7 now exists **with today's created date**, and is linked to the In-App; the _Already exist_ entity is reused, not duplicated; the conflicted entity's pre-existing version is unchanged. `[Story] [live-confirmed]`

> **Read the created-date column** — it is what separates this export's work from previous runs'.

## Open questions

**1. AC "Reduction in manual recreation and export-related errors" is a business metric, not a testable expected result.** No smoke step covers it — recorded so the absence is a deliberate, visible decision. If it is meant to be verifiable it needs a threshold and a measurement source. _(Blocks no step and no run.)_

_(Two earlier open questions are closed: the exported status is In-Review, and conflicts disable Export — both confirmed live.)_

## FE data-testid requests

The destination dropdown, the three summary sections and their entity rows have no stable attributes and were reached by text in every run.

## Notes

* **Lifecycle: short series.** This plan is run a handful of times while the Story is in flight, then retired.
* Allure TestOps case: **not created**. The Jira sub-task is the source of truth. See KING-22214.

fields.description:
### Objective

Enable operators to export an In-App campaign from a source environment to a destination environment, ensuring all dependencies are validated and handled automatically to prevent broken or incomplete campaigns.

Reference PRD: <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-0">https://kinoadev.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/KIN/pages/543883265/Export+In-App</custom>

### Scope

Included:

* Exporting a single In-App campaign and all required dependencies (Player Fields, Events, Audiences, User Lists, A/B Tests, Resources/Bundles, In-App Templates).
* Handling and reporting of conflicts that block export.

### AC

* Operators can export an In-App campaign with a single action.
* All dependencies are validated before export; missing or incompatible entities are reported.
* Exported In-App and its dependencies are created or mapped in the destination environment and set to Draft.
* Clear UI feedback on what will be created, reused, or blocked due to conflicts.
* Reduction in manual recreation and export-related errors.

### Other information

* Exported In-App is initially created as In-review in the destination environment.
